value.rationale: Shore-dependent activation is a natural heterogeneous excitable-medium model, and the theorem exhibits a nontrivial change in the onset of sustained three- and four-phase waves from the uniform threshold-two baseline. It identifies all recurrent structures and counts every labelled transient-time/period class for an infinite two-parameter graph family, not an arbitrary finite sample or a known homogeneous specialization.
